description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for different models and conditions, labeled “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition.” The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled as described above, in the order “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5.  There are five sets of grouped bars, each corresponding to a category on the horizontal axis. Each set contains two bars, with the first bar in a red hue and the second in a blue hue. For “Ours,” the red bar reaches approximately 89.84 and the blue bar reaches approximately 90.57. For “w/o comments,” the red bar reaches approximately 86.82 and the blue bar reaches approximately 85.85. For “w/o select,” the red bar reaches approximately 87.34 and the blue bar reaches approximately 83.02. For “w/o emotion,” the red bar reaches approximately 87.17 and the blue bar reaches approximately 84.91. For “w/o cognition,” the red bar reaches approximately 80.10 and the blue bar reaches approximately 87.74. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
